items.briefing:
Australian organisations are rapidly adopting AI agents without matching governance frameworks in place, which creates real risks around data handling and accountability. Separately, a vulnerability in AI networking tools (OpenClaw) has been identified that could allow attackers to manipulate AI systems — worth flagging for any teams using large language model platforms internally.

**Practical tip:** If your organisation is trialling AI tools or agents, make sure there's a clear policy on what data those tools can access before rolling them out more broadly.

featured.title: Spinnaker names Rex Young as Chief Information Officer
featured.summary: The hire underscores Spinnaker's push to scale global support and AI tools as demand rises for alternatives to vendor-led software services.
